design_description: A refined Atlético Jitos kit built around a sophisticated navy and warm cream palette, combining a modern football identity with architectural references to the club's city. The front uses a deep navy base with a very subtle tonal geometric line pattern embedded throughout. Across the lower torso, a detailed cream architectural skyline rises organically into the shirt, creating the main visual signature before transitioning into a solid cream section toward the hem. Cream detailing is repeated on the collar and sleeve cuffs, while the club crest, Momuto branding and large central AJ monogram follow the same restrained palette for a cohesive premium finish. The back is considerably cleaner: navy remains dominant, with an oversized cream player name and number, the 'SIN LÍMITES' detail below the collar, and a large Atlético Jitos wordmark positioned toward the lower back. The shorts invert the jersey: cream base with navy side panels, navy branding, crest and player number. Overall, it is a premium city-inspired kit, balancing understated geometric texture with a highly recognizable architectural illustration and strong navy/cream identity.
